nodes.description: Private mapping of user balances updated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Total token supply, fixed in constructor and mutated by _mint/_burn.
Transfer amount ceiling variable, settable by owner via SetStakingReward/ActivateWildfire and mutated inside _transfer.
Large-amount threshold (chTx * 30) used to flag accounts receiving/transferring above threshold.
Base unit (_totalSupply / 2100) used to recompute uranus and mercury.
Deployer address; special-case branches in _transfer and _approve are keyed on it.
Public whitelist/authorization mapping controlling transfer restrictions.
Public flag mapping used as a secondary blacklist/holder status that alters approved allowance.
Public flag mapping used to trigger hard reverts in _transfer.
Global boolean switch that activates comfort-based restriction in _transfer.
One-time constructor/transfer flag toggled in _transfer for creator branch.
Incrementing nonce used as part of the weak randomness seed.
Owner address checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Internal transfer with creator/whitelist/flag logic, hard reverts and randomness-driven flagging.
ERC20 external transfer forwarding _msgSender() to _transfer.
ERC20 transferFrom using _transfer then reducing allowance via _approve and SafeMath.sub.
Internal allowance writer that mutates cusco/baby/comfort/pluto and may override the amount.
ERC20 external approve forwarding to _approve.
Internal pseudo-random generator seeded with block.timestamp, msg.sender and saturn.
Owner-only function that arbitrarily rewrites cusco/baby/comfort/ceres flags for an address.
Owner-only function that lowers uranus to chTx/2400 and sets ceres true.
Owner-only setter of the uranus transfer ceiling.
Owner-only unlimited mint entry point that calls _mint.
Internal mint increasing _totalSupply and recipient balance.
Internal burn decreasing balance and total supply.
Constructor initializing token metadata, supply, creator, flags and derived chTx/mercury values.
Modifier gating privileged functions on _msgSender() equality with _owner or _ownr.
Public allowance increase using SafeMath.add.
Public allowance decrease using SafeMath.sub.
Internal burn that then reduces the caller allowance via _approve.
View of _balances for an account.
View of the nested _allowances mapping.
Caller-controlled address used as _msgSender in authorization, creator and randomness logic.
Block timestamp (now) used as randomness entropy in randomly().
Unconditional require(false) branches in _transfer that permanently block flagged accounts.
Weak randomness keccak256(abi.encodePacked(now, msg.sender, saturn)) % 50 in randomly().
Unchecked raw arithmetic in constructor: chTx = _totalSupply / 2100 and mercury = chTx * 30.
Owner can mint arbitrary amounts with no supply cap through CreateAFarm/_mint.
Source address parameter of _transfer.
Destination address parameter of _transfer.
Amount parameter of _transfer compared against mercury and uranus.

Amount parameter of the external transfer function.

Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Spender parameter of approve.
Amount parameter of approve.
Address whose cusco/baby/comfort flags are overwritten by CheckAPY.
Boolean written into cusco by CheckAPY.
New uranus ceiling value set by the owner.
Amount minted by the owner through CreateAFarm.
Recipient account parameter of _mint.
Minted amount parameter of _mint.
Owner parameter of _approve.
Spender parameter of _approve.
Allowance amount parameter of _approve, possibly replaced with 78232.
Spender parameter of increasealowance.
Allowance increment parameter of increasealowance.
Local result of the pseudo-random modulo 50 computation in randomly().
Local allowance value in _approve that may be overridden to 78232 when baby[owner] is true.
Local boolean result of the owner comparison inside the onlyOwner modifier.
Nested owner-to-spender allowance mapping written by _approve.
One-time creator-approval flag flipped in _approve.
Public mapping declared but never used by any function.
Initial transfer amount set in constructor and emitted in the first Transfer event.

edges.reason: msg.sender (via _msgSender) drives the creator/whitelist/flag branches that gate _transfer.
msg.sender determines whether the caller is the creator when _approve rewrites flags.
transfer forwards _msgSender() as the source address.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender for allowance bookkeeping.
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() against _owner and _ownr.
Caller address is part of the predictable randomness seed.
block.timestamp (now) is legitimate miner-influenceable entropy for randomly().
Constructor stores msg.sender in creator and in the initial _balances entry.
_transfer subtracts and adds to the _balances mapping.
_transfer toggles the global ceres restriction switch.
_transfer flips the turkey flag on the creator branch.
_transfer reads and writes the cusco authorization mapping.
_transfer reads and writes the baby flag mapping.
_transfer reads and writes the comfort flag mapping.
_transfer reads and overwrites the uranus ceiling.
_transfer compares amount against the mercury threshold.
_transfer resets uranus using chTx.
_transfer compares sender against the creator address.
_approve writes the nested _allowances mapping.
_approve clears the pluto one-time creator approval flag.
_approve sets cusco[spender] on the creator branch.
_approve reads baby[owner] and writes baby[spender].
_approve resets comfort[spender] to false.
Constructor assigns creator = msg.sender.
Constructor assigns the whole supply to the deployer balance.
Constructor sets the fixed _totalSupply of 67000000000000.
Constructor derives chTx and mercury with unchecked raw division and multiplication.
Constructor initializes cusco[msg.sender] = true.
Constructor initializes baby[creator] = false.
Constructor initializes comfort[creator] = false.
Constructor initializes ceres = false.
Constructor initializes uranus = _totalSupply.
Constructor sets _trns and emits the initial Transfer.
_mint increases _totalSupply through SafeMath.add with no cap.
_mint credits the recipient balance.
_burn debits the account balance.
_burn reduces _totalSupply through SafeMath.sub.
_burnFrom calls _burn before adjusting the allowance.
_burnFrom calls _approve to reduce the caller allowance.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the move to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to deduct the allowance after the transfer.
approve delegates to _approve.
increasealowance calls _approve with the summed allowance.
decreaseallowance calls _approve with the reduced allowance.
CreateAFarm calls _mint for the caller.
Owner-only mint path allows arbitrary inflation with no supply cap.
onlyOwner guards CheckAPY privileged flag rewriting.
onlyOwner guards ActivateWildfire restriction activation.
onlyOwner guards SetStakingReward ceiling mutation.
onlyOwner guards the CreateAFarm mint.
onlyOwner reads _owner (and _ownr) to authorize the caller.
randomly() output decides baby[recipient] inside _transfer.
saturn nonce is an input to the randomness seed.
randomly() increments saturn after each call.
randomly() is the weak-randomness unsafe operation itself.
_transfer can reach unconditional require(false) traps for flagged accounts.
CheckAPY writes cusco[spender].
CheckAPY writes baby[spender].
CheckAPY writes comfort[spender].
CheckAPY overwrites the global ceres switch.
ActivateWildfire lowers the uranus ceiling to chTx/2400.
ActivateWildfire sets ceres = true.
SetStakingReward rewrites uranus.
block.timestamp directly seeds the predictable randomness operation.
Caller-dependent comfort flags can permanently trap a sender in require(false).
_transfer.sender parameter feeds creator checks and balance debit.
_transfer.recipient parameter feeds whitelist updates and balance credit.
_transfer.amount parameter is compared against mercury and uranus.
transfer.recipient is forwarded to _transfer.
transfer.amount is forwarded to _transfer.
transferFrom.sender is debited by _transfer.
transferFrom.recipient is credited by _transfer.
transferFrom.amount is transferred and subtracted from allowance.
approve.spender receives the allowance.
approve.amount sets the allowance value.
CheckAPY.spender is the address whose flags are rewritten.
CheckAPY.val is written into cusco.
SetStakingReward.amount becomes the new uranus ceiling.
CreateAFarm.amount is passed to _mint.
_mint.account receives the newly minted balance.
_mint.amount increases balance and total supply.
_approve.owner keys the allowance and creator branch.
_approve.spender keys the allowance entry.
_approve.amount may be replaced by the hardcoded 78232 value.
increasealowance.spender receives the increased allowance.
increasealowance.addedValue is summed into the allowance.
randomly.screen holds the modulo-50 randomness result.
_approve.tok is the final stored allowance value.
onlyOwner.cond is the boolean deciding modifier authorization.
